name: Battle of Plassey
description: Decisive victory of Robert Clive's East India Company forces over Nawab Siraj-ud-Daulah, aided by Mir Jafar's betrayal. Marked the onset of British colonial dominance in India.

name: Battle of Buxar
description: Company forces led by Hector Munro defeated the combined armies of Nawab Mir Qasim, Nawab Shuja-ud-Daula of Awadh, and Mughal Emperor Shah Alam II, securing total political control over Bengal, Bihar, and Orissa.

name: Santhal Hul (Rebellion)
description: Massive tribal uprising led by brothers Sidhu and Kanhu Murmu against corrupt money-lenders and Company revenue agents, leading to the creation of the Santal Parganas Non-Regulation district.

name: Indigo Revolt (Nil Bidroha)
description: Peasant uprising against forced indigo cultivation by European planters across Nadia, Jessore, and Pabna, immortalized in Dinabandhu Mitra's play 'Nil Darpan'.
